answer: An agent buying a ferrous mirror mount and a prism rejects invoices unless they carry a buyer-signed purchase capability binding the order, supplier key and maximum payment. Settlement checks that signature and atomically consumes the capability before paying. New supplier accounts receive no authority to debit the buyer, and replaying an invoice through aliases cannot spend the same authorization twice. This blocks sybil invoice swarms from draining procurement funds, assuming the buyer key stays secure.
